items.label: fix_sketch
items.evidence: I am thinking you don't have `paper-qa` version 5, likely you have v4. The `Settings` object is new in that version. So you'll want to do something like `pip install paper-qa>=5`.
items.rationale: Identifies the version mismatch and proposes pip install paper-qa>=5, which is what the README change states.
